critical_code_review_comments: deploy_center.py _load_cfg does not roundtrip 'github_token_enc' back into the doc when apply-calls persists (it re-writes the whole 'value' via 'cfg' dict which does include token_enc — OK). However deploy_generate's upsert uses {**cfg, 'secrets': cfg['secrets']} which stores 'github_token_enc' twice-nested only if _load_cfg keys stay flat; keys stay flat here, so fine. Still, the pattern would break if _load_cfg ever nests, so consider explicit field-by-field $set.

ai.py _extract_memory uses model 'gpt-5.4-mini' but production may prefer 'gpt-5.6' per July-2026 releases; ensure the model id is centralized so it can be swapped without touching background extractor.
deploy_apply_calls silently ignores livekit if not in selected — worth returning a warning field so admin knows LiveKit config was skipped.
